The source explicitly states that BLMCA 'incorporates the greedy assignment criterion of the MCA scheme to the BFD-based load balancing heuristic'. The source details that BLMCA uses the MCA criterion for feasible assignments (where load balance is maintained) and falls back to BFD's best-fit criteria otherwise. Furthermore, the source notes that processing heavily loaded mesh-cells first (implied by the sorted order and the logic of avoiding large communication costs) helps minimize deviation from minimal communication cost, effectively prioritizing them to reduce overhead while maintaining balance.
